text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Underwater dash finished. ...That's all 
for today.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Huh, today's workout is pretty light, 
isn't it—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Wait, ah! Right, by tomorrow...!
choice_data_list:
Yeah. Because we need to prepare to head 
to Kokura.

Yeah. Because I have preparations to head 
to Kokura.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Dants-san. I'll be taking my 
leave.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...! Um, good luck! In the Kitakyushu 
Kinen...!!

With the Kitakyushu Kinen fast 
approaching, I temporarily left the summer 
camp grounds and headed with Believe to 
Fukuoka, home of Kokura Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: The flight's... about 2 hours, right?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"Could you give me the latest materials on 
the runners for the Kitakyushu Kinen? I'd 
like to check them."
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'll send it over now.
Yeah, I'll send it over now.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

Following Believe's lead as she opened her 
documents beside me, I also decided to 
review the materials for the Kitakyushu 
Kinen.

"As for my condition—it is progressing 
smoothly. With allies gained and days of 
quiet, steady discipline behind me, I have 
forged undeniable strength."

Therefore, when it comes to Graded stakes 
like the Kitakyushu Kinen... I honestly 
feel confident we can take it.

Next, I open the materials on the 
Sprinters Stakes. With September just 
around the corner, information on the 
contenders has steadily begun to gather—
I look it over and let out a small gulp.
choice_data_list:
(To go up against Umamusume of this 
caliber...)

text_block_list.text:
A glance at the racing records easily 
reveals glamorous accomplishments like 
winning multiple graded stakes. GⅠ races 
are... the pinnacle of that world.

"Furthermore, the Sprinters Stakes has no 
class restrictions. You'll be facing 
Senior-class veterans who debuted earlier 
and have been fighting at the absolute 
top."

"And among them... Are monster-class 
racers who have already claimed victory in 
GⅠ races."

So that was... such a fiercely contested 
battle.

For Believe, this would be her first and 
last chance to achieve the glory of a 
1200m GⅠ victory in the Classic class...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Shouldn't you be heading to the security 
checkpoint soon?

I hastily packed my things and chased 
after Believe. ...First, I have to focus 
on the Kitakyushu Kinen.

Even while thinking that, the thought of 
what else needed to be done before the 
Sprinters Stakes... continued to swirl 
endlessly in my mind.
